name: AC relay coil
summary: An AC relay coil is intended for a specified alternating-current control supply.
description: An AC relay coil is intended for a specified alternating-current control supply. Voltage and frequency form part of its coil rating and cannot be inferred from the relay tag.
readingNotes: Identify the actual control-supply frequency and voltage.

distinction: AC coil suitability does not mean its contacts can switch every AC or DC load.
